Messages.Author: stanles
Messages.Body:
Momentary Delay seems to be worded so that if this, the acting,
vampire ends combat before the press step its not useable? What about
if the blocking vampire ends combat before the press step? Also if
the blocking vampire goes to torpor, or is burned, is that considered
the acting vampire ending combat before the press step, or the
blocking vampire ending combat before the press step - since it's the
blocking vampire not being around which has caused combat to end?

cheers
shawn

Momentary Delay [HttB:C]
Cardtype: Action Modifier
Requires a vampire with capacity 7 or more.
Only usable at the end of an action blocked by an ally or a vampire of
capacity 5 or less (after any combats). Not usable if more than one
round of combat has occurred nor if this vampire has lost 3 or more
blood this action or ended combat before the press step. The action
continues as if unblocked.

Messages.Body:

> Momentary Delay seems to be worded so that if this, the acting,
> vampire ends combat before the press step its not useable?

Correct.

>  What about
> if the blocking vampire ends combat before the press step?

Card text makes no restriction.

> Also if
> the blocking vampire goes to torpor, or is burned, is that considered
> the acting vampire ending combat before the press step,

No.

> or the
> blocking vampire ending combat before the press step - since it's the
> blocking vampire not being around which has caused combat to end?

Neither minion is considered to have ended combat.



He has lost 4 blood in total (ergo, no MD). Card text only keeps a
running count of blood lost, not net loss/gain, and does not state
that blood gain equates to negative blood loss.
